reason: Both sell subscription cloud software to small and mid-sized employers, so customers overlap in part. The products differ. Paylocity sells HR, payroll and finance software, while Thryv sells marketing, CRM and lead-generation software plus done-for-you marketing services. Paylocity also earns interest on client funds, and Thryv has a legacy print directory line. These are weak links, so I graded it adjacent and not direct.
